requirements.title: Register the assumed business name (Fernline Studio)
requirements.agency: Oregon Secretary of State, Corporation Division
requirements.quote: $50.00 ... Anytime you are doing business in Oregon and are not using the legal real and true name of each owner in the title of the business, you must file an Assumed Business Name
requirements.notes: ORS 648.007 bars doing business under an unregistered assumed name; the registration lasts 2 years and must be renewed to keep using the name.

requirements.title: Register for a City of Portland / Multnomah County business tax account
requirements.agency: City of Portland Revenue Division (also administers Multnomah County Business Income Tax)
requirements.quote: Businesses that are operating within the City of Portland and/or Multnomah County (including rideshare drivers) must register for a Revenue Division tax account within 60 days.
requirements.notes: One registration covers the Portland Business License Tax and Multnomah County Business Income Tax; the deadline is 60 days after starting, not before the first sale.

requirements.title: File the annual combined Portland/Multnomah business tax return, even if exempt
requirements.quote: Taxfilers who qualify for an exemption from the City of Portland and/or Multnomah County Business Income Taxes must still file a Business Tax Return with their supporting tax pages.
requirements.notes: Due with the federal and state returns (generally April 15 for calendar-year filers); under $75,000 receipts this return claims the exemption rather than paying tax.

requirements.title: Pay Portland Business License Tax
requirements.quote: Taxfilers are exempt if their gross receipts from all business activities—regardless of where those receipts are earned—amount to less than: ... $75,000 for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2026 and prior to January 1, 2027
requirements.notes: Under $25,000 first-year receipts is below the $75,000 exemption for 2026 (rising to $100,000 for 2027), so no tax is owed, but the return is still filed.

requirements.title: Pay Multnomah County Business Income Tax
requirements.agency: Multnomah County (administered by City of Portland Revenue Division)
requirements.quote: Taxfilers whose gross receipts from all business, both within and without the county, amount to less than $100,000
requirements.notes: Listed among the exemptions; under $25,000 in receipts owes no county business income tax but still files the combined return.

requirements.title: Metro Supportive Housing Services Business Income Tax
requirements.agency: Metro (regional government), administered by City of Portland Revenue Division
requirements.quote: NOTE: If you are a sole proprietor subject to the City of Portland Business License Tax and/or Multnomah County Business Income Tax, you are not liable for the Metro Supportive Housing Services (SHS) Business Income Tax.
requirements.notes: The business tax applies only above $5 million gross receipts in any case; sole proprietors fall under the SHS personal tax instead.

requirements.title: Metro SHS personal income tax
requirements.agency: Metro (regional government), administered by City of Portland Revenue Division
requirements.quote: For tax years 2021 through 2025, the SHS personal tax is owed by individuals with Metro taxable income above $125,000 if filing single or $200,000 if filing joint
requirements.notes: From 2026 the thresholds are indexed for inflation; under $25,000 of business revenue is far below them unless other household income pushes it over.

requirements.title: Multnomah County Preschool for All personal income tax
requirements.agency: Multnomah County, administered by City of Portland Revenue Division
requirements.quote: The PFA personal tax is owed by individuals with Multnomah County taxable income above $125,000 if filing single or $200,000 if filing joint
requirements.notes: A personal tax keyed to total taxable income; the business alone does not reach the threshold.

requirements.title: Home occupation permit for a home office
requirements.quote: Type A home occupation is where you use your home as a place of work and no employees or customers come to the site. ... A permit is not required for Type A home occupations
requirements.notes: No clients visit and no employees, so this is a Type A home occupation: no permit, but it must follow the zoning code rules in 33.203.

requirements.title: File a Confidential Personal Property Return for business equipment
requirements.quote: If you were in business on January 1st, Oregon Revised Statutes (ORS 308.285 – 308.300) require that all business owners file annual Confidential Personal Property Return (CPPR).
requirements.notes: Due March 15 for property held on January 1 (first one in 2027 if operating on January 1, 2027); tax may be canceled under the annual threshold but the return is still expected.

requirements.title: TriMet transit self-employment tax (Form OR-TM)
requirements.agency: Oregon Department of Revenue (for the TriMet transit district)
requirements.quote: People who must pay the self-employment tax include: • Self-employed individuals, sole proprietors, independent contractors, members of a partnership, and persons who have net self-employment earnings greater than $400 from doing business or providing services within the TriMet District.
requirements.notes: Portland is inside the TriMet district; filed separately from the Oregon income tax return if net self-employment earnings exceed $400.

requirements.title: Oregon estimated personal income tax payments
requirements.condition: Expected Oregon tax after credits and withholding of $1,000 or more
requirements.quote: In most cases, you must make estimated tax payments if you expect your tax after credits and withholding will be $1,000 or more, before you subtract any prior year refund you applied to your current year's tax.
requirements.notes: Business profit is reported on the owner's Oregon personal return; quarterly payments only if the owed amount reaches $1,000.

requirements.title: Register for or collect state sales tax
requirements.quote: Oregon doesn't have a general sales or use/transaction tax.
requirements.notes: No seller's permit or sales tax registration exists for design services in Oregon.

requirements.title: Oregon Corporate Activity Tax (CAT) registration or return
requirements.quote: Business or unitary group with $750,000 or less of Oregon commercial activity is excluded from all CAT requirements.
requirements.notes: Registration starts at $750,000 and filing above $1 million; under $25,000 is far below.

requirements.title: State general business license
requirements.quote: The state of Oregon doesn't have a general business license.
requirements.notes: Graphic design is not a licensed occupation, so no state license applies beyond the assumed business name.

requirements.title: Workers' compensation coverage
requirements.agency: Oregon Department of Consumer and Business Services
requirements.quote: There is no requirement to have workers’ compensation coverage if you do not have employees.
requirements.notes: No employees, so no coverage or employer registrations are required.

requirements.title: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN)
requirements.quote: Generally, you need an EIN to: Hire employees Operate a partnership or corporation Pay sales and excise taxes Change business structures or ownership Administer certain trusts, retirement plans and estates
requirements.notes: A sole proprietor with no employees, no partnership and no sales or excise tax can use the owner's SSN; an EIN is optional (often requested by banks).

requirements.title: Self-employment tax and Schedule SE
requirements.quote: You must pay self-employment tax and file Schedule SE (Form 1040) if either of the following applies. Your net earnings from self-employment (excluding church employee income) were $400 or more.
requirements.notes: Business profit goes on Schedule C of the owner's Form 1040; SE tax applies once net earnings reach $400.

requirements.title: Federal quarterly estimated tax payments
requirements.condition: Expected federal tax owed of $1,000 or more when the return is filed
requirements.quote: Individuals, including sole proprietors, partners, and S corporation shareholders, generally have to make estimated tax payments if they expect to owe tax of $1,000 or more when their return is filed.
requirements.notes: Self-employment income has no withholding, so estimated payments are likely once profit is meaningful.

requirements.title: Federal business license or permit
requirements.quote: Business activities regulated by a federal agency will need a federal license or permit.
requirements.notes: Freelance graphic design is not a federally regulated activity, so no federal license applies.

requirements.title: Beneficial ownership information (BOI) report
requirements.quote: U.S. companies are exempt from the Beneficial Ownership Information (BOI) reporting requirements and therefore, are no longer required to file BOI reports.
requirements.notes: A sole proprietorship is not a reporting company, and FinCEN's final rule exempts U.S. companies anyway.

hard_calls.about: Portland/Multnomah registration timing and exempt returns
hard_calls.explanation: The Revenue Division gives 60 days to register rather than requiring registration before the first sale, and businesses under the exemption thresholds must still file a return every year. The City exemption rose from $50,000 to $75,000 for 2026 (Ordinance 192163), so older pages and guides still show $50,000.

hard_calls.about: Business personal property return for a home-office freelancer
hard_calls.explanation: Multnomah County says all business owners in business on January 1 must file by March 15, and the state form says filing applies even when value is below the cancellation threshold; neither page addresses a home office where a laptop or furniture is also used personally (state law exempts items used exclusively for personal use). The current cancellation threshold amount is not stated on the pages checked.

hard_calls.about: Multnomah County uses a non-.gov domain
hard_calls.explanation: Multnomah County's official site is multco.us, so its pages are official but not .gov; Portland's Revenue Division (portland.gov) administers the county business income tax and is the better source for that tax.

hard_calls.about: Metro SHS personal tax thresholds for 2026
hard_calls.explanation: The Revenue Division says SHS personal tax thresholds are indexed for inflation starting in tax year 2026 but the page checked does not state the 2026 amounts; they are above $125,000 single either way, so this case is not affected.
